82.description: This feature vector represents human demographic categories across different ages and genders.

30.description: This vector represents various conjugated forms and inflections of the Portuguese verb "ser" (to be).

41.description: This feature vector activates strongly for characters, locations, and proper nouns from the Harry Potter universe.

24.description: This feature vector represents theatrical and narrative entertainment genres and storytelling arts.

64.description: This feature vector activates strongly on proper names, particularly female given names, alongside words containing root morphemes related to personal relationships, historical eras, or social titles.

141.description: This vector represents morphological variations, inflections, and roots of Portuguese words containing the letter sequence "iv" (or related adjectival and verbal suffixes).

132.description: These tokens represent transitive or intransitive verbs frequently followed by prepositional phrases starting with "to," "on," or "upon."

78.description: This feature vector activates on common Romance-language derivational suffixes and adverbial endings, particularly those related to abstract nouns and adverbs in Portuguese, Italian, and English.

77.description: This vector represents Portuguese adverbs and quantifiers used to express degree, frequency, and amount.

161.description: This vector represents common word roots, prefixes, and grammatical forms in Romance languages, particularly Spanish and Portuguese.
